# The generated files are in this folder but not in the repository (git lists them untracked),
# and the ruleset main does not require ci: the files are to propose, and the protection is not
# compared (with the check or without) until they are merged.
CALLED ^git status --porcelain -- .*web/go\.mod
OUTPUT "item": "declaration".*"action": "propose"
OUTPUT "item": "components", "state": "as declared", "action": "none"
OUTPUT "item": "ci", "state": "as declared", "action": "none"
OUTPUT "item": "protection".*"action": "none"
OUTPUT "item": "protection", "state": "not checked until the change is merged"
OUTPUT "status": "would-update"
OUTPUT_NOT requires ci
OUTPUT_NOT nothing to do
NOT_CALLED --method|^gh pr create|^git (switch|add|commit|-c credential)
